author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Has Adam Savage ever had to deal with the awkwardness of a creator asking for an opinion on material he actually disliked? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers this question from Tested member Thomas_Esson, whom we thank for his support! How do you handle giving negative feedback?
